data.name: Imelda
data.gender_notes: Imelda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Imelda is derived from the Latin word ‘emelius’, which means ‘devoted to God’. In Christian tradition, Imelda is the name of a noble Spanish girl who lived in the 13th century and is revered as a saint. According to legend, she was known for her exceptional piety and generosity to the poor. On the eve of her wedding day, she was visited by three angels disguised as beggars. Moved by their distress, Imelda gave them all her jewels and fine clothes. The next day, when her fiancé arrived to claim her, he found her wearing only a hair shirt, and she died of joy upon seeing the king of Heaven.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion, piety, and generosity to those in need.
data.etymology: Imelda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loyal servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imelda total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אימלדה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא עוזרי, הוא עם כל טוב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אימלדה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בגרמנית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא עוזרי' או 'הוא עם כל טוב'. השם מורכב משני חלקים: 'אימ' שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא' ו-'לדה' שפירושו 'עוזרי' או 'עם כל טוב'. השם אימלדה מופיע בתרבויות נוצריות שונות ומשויך לנשים שונות בתקופות היסטוריות שונות.

in_greek.name: Ιμέλδα
in_greek.meaning: Θεός με βοηθά, Θεός με όλα καλά
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Ιμέλδα είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Θεός με βοηθά' ή 'Θεός με όλα καλά'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: 'Ιμ' που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και '-ελδα' που σημαίνει 'βοηθά' ή 'με όλα καλά'. Το όνομα Ιμέλδα απαντάται σε διάφορες χριστιανικές παραδόσεις και συνδέεται με διάφορες γυναίκες σε διαφορετικές ιστορικές περιόδους.

in_latin.name: Imelda
in_latin.meaning: Deus meus adiutor, Deus meus cum omni bono
in_latin.long_meaning: Imelda est nomen christianum quod originem habet in lingua germanica et significat 'Deus meus adiutor' vel 'Deus meus cum omni bono'. Nomen constat ex duabus partibus: 'Im' quod significat 'Deus' et '-elda' quod significat 'adiutor' vel 'cum omni bono'. Nomen Imelda in variis traditionibus christianis invenitur et cum diversis mulieribus in diversis temporibus historicis coniungitur.

in_english.name: Imelda
in_english.meaning: God is my helper, God is with all good
in_english.long_meaning: Imelda is a Christian name derived from Germanic roots, meaning 'God is my helper' or 'God is with all good'. The name consists of two parts: 'Im' meaning 'God' and '-elda' meaning 'helper' or 'with all good'. Imelda appears in various Christian traditions and is associated with different women throughout history. The name symbolizes divine assistance and goodness, reflecting a strong spiritual significance in Christian culture.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Imelda is derived from the Old German name "Hildgundis", meaning "battle- warrior of the Goddess Hilde". In Christianity, Imelda is remembered for her deep piety and devotion to the poor, symbolized by her miraculous vision of a pair of roses blooming in the snow, from which she drew nourishment. Symbolically, Imelda represents the warrior spirit that remains steadfast and dedicated to their faith, even in the face of adversity. Spiritually, she embodies the virtue of compassion, as she extends herself to help those in need, no matter the conditions.
